'''Rasta Aliens'''<ref name="Hint Book">''[[Star Wars Hint Book]]''</ref> were a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that had spines on their calves, a long rippling strain near their neck, and short stubs on their heads.<ref name="SWNES">[[Star Wars (1991 video game)|''Star Wars'' video game (1991)]]</ref> Known as dangerous predators, they were capable of shooting deadly spikes from their abdomen in three-pronged bursts.<ref name="Hint Book" /> They could be found in the deserts of the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], where they primarily kept to caves,<ref name="Hint Book" /> including the [[Tusken Cave]] where many [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] could be found as well.<ref name="SWNES" />

==Behind the scenes==
Although unnamed in [[1991]]'s [[Star Wars (1991 video game)|''Star Wars'' video game]] and its manual,<ref name="SWNES" /> these aliens were identified in the ''[[Star Wars Hint Book]]''.<ref name="Hint Book" /> They are encountered by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in various caves in the Tatooine levels of the video game.<ref name="SWNES" />

An article in an issue of the magazine [[Wikipedia:Nintendo Power|''Nintendo Power'']] referred to them as "Sand People," as if they were a separate species from Tusken Raiders. The article also says they "release energy from their bodies"<ref name="NP">{{StoryCite|story=Star Wars (article)|book=Wikipedia:Nintendo Power|bformatted=''Nintendo Power'' Vol. 28|sformatted=''Star Wars''}}</ref> as opposed to the spikes mentioned in the ''Star Wars Hint Book''.<ref name="Hint Book" />
